summary: Turns a setting on or off with immediate effect, like a light switch. No save button needed.

p.label: Weekly digest
p.description: A summary of token changes every Monday.

whenToUse: Settings that apply as soon as they are flipped: notifications, auto-publish, preview mode.
labelPlacement start in settings lists, so labels align left and switches align right.
whenNotToUse: A choice saved later with a form button: use Checkbox.
More than two states: use RadioGroup or Select.
Starting an action (Publish, Sync): use Button.

dos.title: Name the setting, not the state
dos.text: The switch shows on or off; the label says what is on or off.

donts.title: Labels that change with the state
donts.text: "On" and "Off" labels repeat what the control already shows and hide what it controls.

donts.title: A switch that waits for Save
donts.text: Users expect a switch to act at once. Inside a form that saves later, use a Checkbox.

accessibility: Base UI Switch: role switch with aria-checked; Space and Enter toggle it; the label row is the click target.
The off track uses control.track (3:1 against surfaces) and the thumb keeps 3:1 against the track, so the state is visible without color.
The thumb position carries the state, not only the track color.
If flipping it fails (network), revert it and say why next to it.
contentGuidelines: Noun phrase in sentence case: "Review requests", "Auto-publish approved tokens".
Put consequences in the description, one short sentence.
